reasoning_steps: The claim that mRNA COVID-19 vaccines alter or permanently change human DNA is scientifically false

According to genomic researchers, molecular biologists, and major public health organizations such as the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the CDC, mRNA vaccines do not have the capability to alter human DNA
The mRNA from the vaccines is translationally active only in the cell cytoplasm and does not enter the cell nucleus where human DNA is stored
Furthermore, human cells lack the reverse transcriptase enzymes required to convert the vaccine mRNA into DNA, meaning integration into the host genome is biologically impossible
The mRNA degrades naturally shortly after providing the instructions to produce the spike protein.
